integration.folder_hint: Adds/removes right-click entries (Explorer) or file-manager actions (Nautilus, Dolphin, Nemo)
display.title: Display
tab.new_hover: New tab with this tab's folders, Live mode, and exclusions
tab.switch_scanning: Scan running — switch here to watch or cancel it

folders.add_hover: Pick a folder to also search (appends)

filters.title: Filters
filters.name: Name contains:
filters.name_hover: Substring matched against the full path
filters.regex_hover: Regular expression matched against the full path
filters.fuzzy_hover: Fuzzy pattern matched against the file name
filters.content_hover: Substring that must appear in file contents (first 1 MiB)
filters.glob_hover: Wildcard: * spans separators, ? matches one char
filters.or_hover: Comma-separated: a file matches when ANY of these substrings hits
filters.not_hover: Comma-separated: a file matches only when NONE of these substrings hits
filters.min_hover: Minimum file size (inclusive): plain bytes, or KB/MB/GB/TB suffix
filters.max_hover: Maximum file size (inclusive): plain bytes, or KB/MB/GB/TB suffix
filters.after_hover: Only entries modified after this time (UTC)
filters.before_hover: Only entries modified before this time (UTC)
filters.exclude_hover: Skip-list: substring, or glob when it contains * or ?
filters.ext_hover: Extension allow-list: leading dots ignored, case-insensitive
filters.ignorecase_hover: Case-insensitive name, content, glob, and regex matching
filters.showhidden_hover: Include hidden and system files (dotfiles on Linux)
filters.presets_hover: Apply this preset's exclusions and extensions
filters.saved_combo_hover: Pick a saved search, then Load
filters.saved_name_hover: Name for the Save button below
filters.saved_save_hover: Save current filters under this name

status.pick_folder: Pick a folder or enter a root path first.
status.enter_db: Enter a DB path to search an index.
status.index_missing: Index file not found: {db} — build it from the Indexer panel below.
status.daemon_folder: Enter a folder to index first.
status.daemon_db: Enter a DB path to index into first.
status.daemon_idle_hover: Background indexer: when it last ran and whether its view is stale

results.export_excel_hover: Export all hits as Excel XML
results.print_hover: Open an HTML print view in the browser
results.copy_hover: Copy checked paths to the clipboard

results.rowcheck_hover: Check for bulk actions (copy, move, delete, export)

preview.empty: Select a row to preview its contents.
modal.delete_body: Permanently delete {n} selected files and folders? There is no recycle-bin round trip.
modal.move_body: Move {n} selected files to {dest}? Permanent like delete; existing names are skipped, never overwritten.
modal.groups_sub: Clicking a group chip replaces the Extensions field.
modal.groups_delete_hover: Delete this custom group (a built-in of the same name shows again)
modal.groups_name_hover: Display name for the custom group (same name replaces)
modal.groups_add_hover: Save as a custom group (same name replaces)
modal.help_s1b: Toggle Drives for whole volumes, + Add folder to append, x removes one, or paste `;`-separated paths into Edit. Switching tabs switches folders.
modal.help_s2b: Name, Regex (Rust syntax), Fuzzy, file Content, Glob (*.rs), Any-of (OR) / None-of (NOT), sizes (bytes or 10M/1G), dates (YYYY-MM-DD), Exclude skip-list, Extensions or group chips (replace, click again to clear; Manage edits customs), Ignore case, Show hidden.
modal.help_s3b: Big Scan & search button or Enter. Refresh re-runs keeping the selection. Live auto-runs edits (off by default). Empty searches never run — put * in Glob for everything.
modal.help_s4b: Small headers sort, Go jumps pages, checkboxes feed Copy paths / Move / Delete and the CSV–TXT–HTML–Excel–RTF exports. Saved searches and Recent snapshots restore every filter including folders, OR/NOT, and hidden.
modal.help_keys_body: Enter searches · Esc drops focus / closes dialogs · ↑/↓ moves selection · Space checks a row · Tab moves between controls.
